findings.title: Heap-based buffer overflow in cw_acd daemon (FG-IR-25-084, CVE-2025-25249)
findings.summary_md: Fortinet's advisory, initially published January 13, 2026, describes CVE-2025-25249 as a heap-based buffer overflow in the FortiOS and FortiSwitchManager cw_acd daemon allowing remote unauthenticated code execution via crafted requests. Affected releases span FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.3, 7.4.0 through 7.4.8, 7.2.0 through 7.2.11, 7.0.0 through 7.0.17, all FortiOS 6.4, and FortiSwitchManager 7.2.0 through 7.2.6 and 7.0.0 through 7.0.5, with fixes at 7.6.4, 7.4.9, 7.2.12, 7.0.18, 7.2.7 and 7.0.6. Suggested workarounds remove fabric access per interface or block CAPWAP-CONTROL on UDP 5246 to 5249 through a local-in policy. The page credits internal discovery by Gwendal Guégniaud of the Fortinet Product Security Team and still lists Known Exploited as No.

findings.title: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center Software Authentication Bypass Vulnerability (cisco-sa-onprem-fmc-authbypass-5JPp45V2, CVE-2026-20079)
findings.summary_md: Cisco first published this advisory on March 4, 2026 as part of the March 2026 Secure Firewall bundled publication, scoring CVE-2026-20079 CVSS 10.0 for an unauthenticated web interface authentication bypass caused by an improper boot-time system process that ends in script execution and root access on FMC. First fixed releases are 7.0.10, 7.2.12, 7.4.8, 7.6.6, 7.7.13, 10.0.2 and 10.1.0, and no workarounds exist. The advisory gives an exploitation indicator: zgrep "package_info.*license" on /var/log/messages* in expert mode, looking for /var/tmp/license.tmp run by the www user as root. Revision history shows exploitation acknowledgment added August 2026 and the vulnerability was found by Brandon Sakai of Cisco during internal security testing.

findings.title: NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Security Bulletin for CVE-2026-19489 and CVE-2026-19490 (CTX696939)
findings.summary_md: Citrix published bulletin CTX696939 on August 19, 2026, rating CVE-2026-19490 CVSS v4 9.3 as an authentication bypass using an alternate path that applies when the appliance is a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server, with SAML action involvement required on builds 14.1-43.56 or later and 13.1-61.28 or later. Fixed builds are 14.1-73.32, 13.1-63.21, 14.1-73.32 FIPS and 13.1-37.277, with no workarounds. Customers are told to inspect configs for "add authentication samlAction", "add vpn vserver" and "add authentication vserver" to determine exposure. Cloud Software Group credited Samarth Vashisht of the pen-test team at JPMorgan Chase.

findings.title: ETR: CVE-2026-19490 Critical Vulnerability Affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
findings.summary_md: Rapid7's analysis of the August 19, 2026 Citrix advisory notes CVE-2026-19490 is remotely exploitable by an unauthenticated attacker without user interaction at CVSS v4 9.3, affecting NetScaler ADC and Gateway before 14.1-73.32 and 13.1-63.21. Rapid7 stated it had not observed exploitation in the wild as of August 19 but urged emergency patching because perimeter Citrix products are routinely targeted. The post frames NetScaler Gateway's remote access role as the reason auth bypass flaws there are nearly always exploited eventually.

findings.title: Hackers target critical Citrix NetScaler auth bypass in attacks
findings.summary_md: BleepingComputer reported on September 4, 2026 that attackers had begun targeting CVE-2026-19490 after a credible proof of concept appeared online. Previdian founder Ryan Dewhurst said one of the company's NetScaler sensors received PoC-matching requests on September 3 from three distinct source IPs in Australia, the United States and Germany, evidence of exploitation attempts that does not confirm successful compromise. Citrix had not flagged exploitation in its August 19 advisory.

findings.title: Stable Channel Update for Desktop (Chrome 153)
findings.summary_md: Google promoted Chrome 153 to stable on Tuesday, September 8, 2026 with builds 153.0.8010.36 for Linux and 153.0.8010.36/.37 for Windows and Mac, carrying 230 security fixes. CVE-2026-87491, an out of bounds write in V8, is listed as Medium with a $3,000 reward, reported by Jihyeon Jeong of the Compsec Lab at Seoul National University on 2026-08-06. The post states Google is aware that an exploit for CVE-2026-87491 exists in the wild.

findings.title: Critical FortiGate Flaw Exploited: PivotC2 RAT campaign against CVE-2025-25249
findings.summary_md: Reporting on SOCRadar Threat Research Unit findings published September 9, 2026, hours before the KEV listing, says exploitation of CVE-2025-25249 began no later than July 2026 and remains active. The campaign targeted more than 30,000 FortiGate IP addresses and produced 178 confirmed PivotC2 infections, with the United States the most affected. The attack delivers unauthenticated RCE through crafted CAPWAP traffic to UDP port 5246 using a self-extracting Linux binary named fortirun.bin that abuses CAPWAP discovery responses to defeat ASLR and corrupts linked-list pointers for an arbitrary write primitive.
